differences: Dataset: v0.10 used gold-cases/v1 version 1.0.0; v0.12 uses gold-cases/v2 version 2.0.0 with provenance and 32 verified labels.
Prompts/evaluator: v0.11 introduced candidate filtering (v0.11.1) and the v2 provenance-aware labels; v0.12 pins prompt planner-v1 / compact compact-ir-v2 and evaluator 1.0.1.
Coverage: v0.10 was a full 32-case x 3-provider x 3-repeat matrix; v0.11 was a 12-case affected subset x 3 providers x 2 repeats; v0.12 is a full 32 x 3 x 3 matrix again.
Models: requests are gpt-6-sol, claude-sonnet-5-5 and gemini-3.6-flash; the manifest records the observed model ids.
The three reports are shown side by side and are not spliced into one aggregate.

governance.note: Labels are author judgement plus a deterministic adjudicator proxy; no independent human review was performed.

limitations: The benchmark measures agreement with this project's 32-case labels, not absolute truth.
Three repeats show run-to-run variation; they are not a population sample.
Provider models and prices change; results are pinned to the recorded ids and date.
Docentric AX runtime compatibility remains not_tested.
No independent human review was performed; AT-07 stays partial.

metric_definitions.abstention_rate: runs with at least one needs-review requirement and no selected path
metric_definitions.cost_per_template_usd: cost / completed logical run; separate per semantically passed run
metric_definitions.latency_p50_p95_ms: p50/p95 latency over completed logical runs
metric_definitions.review_rate: runs with at least one review row / executed runs
metric_definitions.semantic_pass_rate: logical runs passing every semantic assertion / evaluable runs
metric_definitions.semantic_precision: correct predicted bindings / all predicted bindings
metric_definitions.semantic_recall: correct predicted bindings / all expected bindings
metric_definitions.valid_template_rate: completed logical runs whose plan parsed, expanded and passed IR/schema validation, before compilation
metric_definitions.wrong_binding_rate: incorrect predicted bindings / all predicted bindings
